import re

MAX_DESC_LEN = 4000
HARD_DROP_LEN = 12000

KEYWORDS = (
    'error', 'Error', 'failed', 'Fail',
    'exception', 'panic', 'Oops',
    'NULL pointer', 'invalid',
    'BUG', 'Kernel panic',
    'arm_copy_from_user'
)

HEX_DUMP_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*[0-9a-f]{4,}:\s*[0-9a-f ]+$', re.I)
ASM_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*[0-9a-f]{4,}\s+e[0-9a-f ]{10,}', re.I)
STACK_ADDR_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*[0-9a-f]{8}\s+[0-9a-f ]{16,}', re.I)


def extract_key_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = text.splitlines()
    result = []
    for l in lines:
        if any(k in l for k in KEYWORDS):
            result.append(l.strip())
    return result


def extract_backtrace(text: str, limit=20) -> list[str]:
    bt = []
    for l in text.splitlines():
        if ' from [' in l or l.strip().startswith('[<'):
            bt.append(l.strip())
        if len(bt) >= limit:
            break
    return bt


def clean_description(raw: str) -> str:
    if not raw:
        return ""

    # 直接短内容返回
    if len(raw) <= MAX_DESC_LEN:
        return raw.strip()

    lines = raw.splitlines()
    cleaned = []

    for l in lines:
        if HEX_DUMP_RE.match(l):
            continue
        if ASM_RE.match(l):
            continue
        if STACK_ADDR_RE.match(l):
            continue
        cleaned.append(l)

    text = "\n".join(cleaned)

    # 仍然超长 → 进入摘要模式
    # if len(text) > HARD_DROP_LEN:
    #     key_lines = extract_key_lines(text)
    #     backtrace = extract_backtrace(text)

    #     summary = []
    #     if key_lines:
    #         summary.append("=== Key Errors ===")
    #         summary.extend(key_lines[:30])

    #     if backtrace:
    #         summary.append("\n=== Backtrace (partial) ===")
    #         summary.extend(backtrace)

    #     text = "\n".join(summary)

    # 最终截断
    half = MAX_DESC_LEN // 2

    if len(text) > MAX_DESC_LEN and len(text) > half * 2:
        text = (
            text[:half]
            + '\n[TRUNCATED]\n'
            + text[-half:]
        )

    return text.strip()


# n8n 主逻辑
results = []

for item in items:
    data = item.get("json", {})
    desc = data.get("description", "")

    cleaned_desc = clean_description(desc)

    data["description"] = cleaned_desc
    results.append({"json": data})

return results

description = item.get("description", "")

# 1️⃣ 合并内容，顺序：summary -> description -> comments
combined_lines = []

def add_lines(text):
    if not text:
        return
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        # 跳过 URL 行
        if line.startswith("http://") or line.startswith("https://"):
            continue
        combined_lines.append(line)


# summary

# description
add_lines(description)

# comments

    add_lines(c)

# 2️⃣ 分块，每块最大4000字符，以完整行为单位
MAX_CHARS = 4000
chunks = []
current_chunk = ""

for line in combined_lines:
    # +1 是为了加上换行符
    if len(current_chunk) + len(line) + 1 > MAX_CHARS:
        chunks.append({"json": {"text": current_chunk}})
        current_chunk = line  # 新块从当前行开始
    else:
        if current_chunk:
            current_chunk += "\n" + line
        else:
            current_chunk = line

# 添加最后一块
if current_chunk:
    chunks.append({"json": {"text": current_chunk}})

# 3️⃣ 返回结果给 n8n
return chunks

import re

item = items[0]["json"]

desc = item.get("description", "") or ""
summary = item.get("summary", "") or ""
comments = item.get("comments", []) or []
jira_key = item.get("jira_key", "") or ""

# --------------- helper ---------------
def uniq(seq):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for x in seq:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            out.append(x)
    return out

# --------------- 1️⃣ xts_type ---------------
xts_type_candidates = []

for text in [summary, desc]:
    m = re.search(r"(GTS|CTS|VTS|STS|NTS)", text, re.I)
    if m:
        xts_type_candidates.append(m.group(1).upper())

for c in comments:
    m = re.search(r"(GTS|CTS|VTS|STS|NTS)", c, re.I)
    if m:
        xts_type_candidates.append(m.group(1).upper())

xts_type_candidates = uniq(xts_type_candidates)
xts_type = xts_type_candidates[0] if xts_type_candidates else None


# --------------- 2️⃣ test_module（单独列表） ---------------
module_pattern = re.compile(
    r"(Gts\w*Cases|Cts\w*Cases|Vts\w*Cases|Tvts\w*Cases)",
    re.I
)

module_candidates = []

# summary / desc
for text in [summary, desc]:
    module_candidates.extend(module_pattern.findall(text))

# comments
for c in comments:
    module_candidates.extend(module_pattern.findall(c))

module_pattern = re.compile(
    r"(Gts\w*\b|Cts\w*\b|Vts\w*\b|Tvts\w*\b)",
)

# summary / desc
for text in [summary, desc]:
    module_candidates.extend(module_pattern.findall(text))

# comments
for c in comments:
    module_candidates.extend(module_pattern.findall(c))

# 去重但保持顺序
test_module_list = uniq(module_candidates)


# --------------- 3️⃣ failed_tests ---------------
failed_tests = []

table_pattern = re.compile(
    r"(com\.[^\s#]+|android\.[^\s#]+)#(test[^\s\",|]+)"
)

# desc
for text in [summary, desc]:
  for m in table_pattern.finditer(text):
      failed_tests.append((m.group(1).strip(), m.group(2).strip()))

# comments
for c in comments:
    for m in table_pattern.finditer(c):
        failed_tests.append((m.group(1).strip(), m.group(2).strip()))

# if not failed_tests:
#     table_pattern = re.compile(
#         r"(\btest[^\s\"|]+\b)"
#     )
    
#     # desc
#     for text in [summary, desc]:
#       for m in table_pattern.finditer(text):
#           failed_tests.append((None, m.group(1).strip()))
    
#     # comments
#     for c in comments:
#         for m in table_pattern.finditer(c):
#             failed_tests.append((None, m.group(1).strip()))

# 去重
failed_tests_unique = []
seen = set()
for tc, ti in failed_tests:
    key = f"{tc}#{ti}"
    if key not in seen:
        seen.add(key)
        failed_tests_unique.append({
            "test_case": tc,
            "test_item": ti
        })


# --------------- 输出 ---------------
return [{
    "json": {
        "xts_type": xts_type,
        "test_module": test_module_list,
        "failed_count": len(failed_tests_unique),
        "failed_tests": failed_tests_unique,
        "current_jira_key": jira_key
    }
}]
